_about: Final narration: one normal male voice for every line, natural speed in the files; the trailer plays each line at 1.2x with pitch preserved (browser time-stretch). Run: python video/generated/tts.py --lines vo_final.json --voice Iapetus
voice_style: Speak in a normal, natural male voice, like a clear and friendly presenter. Conversational, not dramatic, not announcer-like.

lines.text: Cancer is a word. Waiting is a number.
A computer can never be held accountable. We agree.
In our framework, each dot is a patient. The piles are the waiting. A few take the fast track.
A model reads the notes and suggests a fast track when immediate care is needed.
Our framework sits between: clinicians define each pipeline, the system runs it, and when the model is unsure, a doctor reviews the case.
Our suggestion: pilot one clinician-validated pipeline in one wellbeing county, tracking treatment within target times. More time for hard cases and the human encounter.
Doctors either trust AI too little and check everything, or too much and check nothing.
Built with Nemotron, powered by Verda.
Waiting is a decision nobody made.
